subject: Request to stagger customer walkthrough — aligning with FY forecast lock
messages:
From: Carlos Rivera <c.rivera@evercord.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Nicole Lee <nicole.lee@evercord.com>, finance-ops@evercord.com
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot walkthrough — suggested times

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick conversation yesterday. The team is excited to see the pilot walkthrough. We're aiming for a 60-minute session focused on integration points and cost/latency profiles.

Suggested windows (PDT):
- Tue, Oct 6: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed, Oct 7: 09:00–10:00

Note: Finance wants a short 15-minute sync right after the demo to confirm purchase timing (they prefer Oct 8–9). I copied Nicole + finance-ops to coordinate. Also attaching an updated M.A.P. with proposed milestones.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v2.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Carlos
Head of Platform Partnerships
Evercord

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Rivera <c.rivera@evercord.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Nicole Lee <nicole.lee@evercord.com>, finance-ops@evercord.com
Date: 2026-10-02T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot walkthrough — suggested times

Carlos — thanks for sending this over and for attaching the M.A.P. Quick update from our side: our client engagements team is in the middle of the FY forecast lock next week. A bunch of people who would normally join demos (product engineering and the solutions lead) are traveling between Oct 5–9 for planning reviews.

Because finance at Evercord also wants the short sync, I'd prefer we avoid trying to cram everything into Oct 6–8. Two options that would keep the momentum without risking missing stakeholders:

1) Stagger the walkthrough: host a 40-minute technical demo with engineering leads on Oct 13 (morning) and a 20-minute commercial + finance wrap on Oct 14. This keeps the demo focused and makes the finance decision meeting short.

2) Push the full 60-minute session to Oct 20 when both engineering and product are back and we've completed our internal forecast lock.

If Evercord's procurement timeline requires decisions the week of Oct 12, option (1) is my recommended compromise. I attached a small calendar snapshot showing team availability.

Can you confirm what your finance team prefers and whether either window works? I can lock the invites once we agree.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

[Attachment: calendar_snapshot.ics]

From: Carlos Rivera <c.rivera@evercord.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Nicole Lee <nicole.lee@evercord.com>, finance-ops@evercord.com
Date: 2026-10-03T08:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot walkthrough — suggested times

Marissa — appreciate the context and the proposed options. Finance confirmed they want the commercial decision window the week of Oct 12 but are flexible on a short pre-sync. Given that, option (1) sounds ideal: technical walkthrough with engineering on Oct 13, then a compressed finance/decision call on Oct 14.

Couple of requests from our side:
- Can you share a 10-slide demo plan (high level) ahead of the technical session so our engineers can flag integration questions?
- Would Redwood's solutions engineer be able to do a brief pre-demo run on Oct 12?

I'll have Nicole coordinate attendee names and send a tentative calendar invite this afternoon.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Carlos

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Rivera <c.rivera@evercord.com>, Nicole Lee <nicole.lee@evercord.com>, finance-ops@evercord.com
Date: 2026-10-04T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot walkthrough — suggested times

Team — quick internal sync to confirm assignments and next steps for the staggered approach Carlos approved:

- Ben: lead the 40-minute technical demo on Oct 13 at 10:00 PDT. Focus: integration pattern, data flow, latency profiles, KV/prefix caching recommendations. (Prep: 10-slide demo plan; due EOD Oct 11)
- Lauren: handle the commercial + finance wrap on Oct 14 at 11:00 PDT. Focus: licensing options, expected per-token cost with suggested batching/caching levers, and procurement next steps. (Prep: 1-page cost summary; due EOD Oct 12)
- Aditya: solutions-engineer pre-demo run on Oct 12 at 09:00 PDT to validate live model access and VPC routing tests. (Prep: test checklist; due Oct 11)

Carlos/Nicole: please send the attendee list and any specific integration docs you want covered. I'll upload the M.A.P. final to the HubSpot deal after Ben's deck arrives. Attached: the calendar snapshot I referenced.

If anything changes on your side (travel or forecast reopen), flag here and we'll adapt. Otherwise I'll send final invites and the draft demo plan links tomorrow.

—
Marissa

[Attachment: calendar_snapshot.ics]
